title: Starlane 2025
about: STARLANE 2025: surf a glowing lane into the screen on SPROUT·256, the handheld 1995 dreamed of for 2025. Written in Sprout. Boost, jump, spin and bomb with four buttons.
line: The first SPROUT·256 game: surf a glowing lane into a striped sunset, with four buttons in an arc to boost, jump, spin and bomb.
